info.name: Certified API Collection
info.description: Postman collection for the Certified Online Learning & Certification Platform API. Endpoints are preserved from the project API. The collection uses {{base_url}} and contains positive and negative API checks. File-upload requests use a placeholder path; select a local image file in Postman before sending them.
